name: A Carefully-packed Crate
summary: A Carefully-packed Crate carries eggs from Tanaris to Erelas Ambersky in Rut’theran Village. The druid tends the eggs until they hatch and trains the young hippogryphs.

sections.title: The Shipment
sections.body: Erelas Ambersky cares for the eggs in Rut’theran Village, a small village in southern Teldrassil. Once they hatch, he trains the young hippogryphs. He asks you to carry the crate safely from Tanaris, where Curgle provides the shipment.

faq.answer: The Carefully-packed Crate holds eggs for Erelas Ambersky to tend until they hatch.
Erelas Ambersky is a druid in Rut’theran Village who cares for the eggs and trains the young hippogryphs.
The crate goes to Erelas Ambersky in Rut’theran Village, a small village in southern Teldrassil.
Curgle provides the shipment of eggs for Erelas Ambersky.

faq.q: Why are the eggs being sent?
faq.answer: Erelas tends the eggs until they hatch, then trains the young hippogryphs.

angles.text: As a druid, you know the work of tending living things. Erelas cares for the eggs and trains the young hippogryphs.
